scope: Local mathematical interventions on saved operands; no full CNS claim.
PN_selection: All annotated ALPNs in canonical male_v10, with actual outgoing transmission state; fine-PN ownership tested separately, never equated to all ALPN.
JVP: Analytic derivative of frozen generic tanh law in the finite observed PN transmission difference; compare reciprocal nonlinear substitution, keeping receiver input from all other cells and receiver state. FP64 algebra is diagnostic, not FP32 bit parity.
JVP_falsifier: Relative prediction error>=1 or signed DNb05 effect wrong; when finite delta=0 report derivative and non-identifiability, no division by zero.

conductance_probe.conductance_scale: gain_i for both E and I (dimensionless engineering only)
conductance_probe.current_control: Freeze conductance reversal factors at V0 and leak coefficient at total initial conductance; preserve value and E/I sensitivities at V0; test finite perturbations and equal E/I increment.
conductance_probe.selection_rule: No selection from rescue of DNg100; select only after algebraic validity and explicit basal drift measured.

intrinsic_probe.baseline_reference: Own initial q, not a desired motion target
intrinsic_probe.controls: Same local q/net with h=0; matched constant bias equal to dynamic bias time average is retrospective explanatory control only, not a new biological fit
intrinsic_probe.falsifier: No new selective response beyond a constant bias; a zero local reference cannot independently rescue a silent cell with fixed negative margin
